occurrences.text: For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
